strings.house.harkonnen.intro: From the dark world of Giedi Prime the savage House Harkonnen has spread across the universe.A cruel people, we Harkonnen are ruthless towards both friend and foe in our fanatical pursuit of power.Do you wish to join House Harkonnen?
strings.campaign.harkonnen.1.briefing: I am the Mentat, Radnor.For your first test you will be expected to produce 1000 credits, and not a granule less.You may earn credits by harvesting spice, and will need to build a refinery to convert spice to credits.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.1.victory: You have pleased me.Continue to serve me well, and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.1.defeat: You are beneath my contempt.Do you know what happens to those who have failed House Harkonnen?
strings.campaign.harkonnen.1.hints: First build concrete slabs, and then build a Windtrap and place it upon the concrete.Do the same for a refinery so that you can reach your quota of 1000 credits.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.2.briefing: House Harkonnen will now allow you to take command in a more dangerous area.You will encounter the worthless Atreides in this region.Whether you eliminate them or accumulate 2700 credits in spice, that is up to you.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.2.victory: Again you have pleased me.You remind me of myself in my youth.You may indeed have true Harkonnen blood coursing through your veins!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.2.defeat: I cannot believe that you were incapable of accumulating your quota.It was a simple task.I suggest you do not try my patience further.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.2.hints: Once you have an Outpost, you will be able to build a Barracks which produces our elite Troopers.I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.3.briefing: The despised Ordos in this region are harvesting spice that rightfully belongs to the House Harkonnen.Destroy the Ordos installations in this area and assert control in the name of House Harkonnen.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.3.victory: Congratulations.You are making progress.Several of my associates have expressed pessimism concerning your abilities.I am glad that you have proved them wrong.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.3.defeat: I knew it!Several of my associates had expressed confidence, but I knew that you were too weak to be a Harkonnen commander!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.3.hints: You need to build a Vehicle Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.4.briefing: One small victory does not win the war.Another region has the misfortune to be infested with vermin from House Ordos, and now you must face the disgusting Ordos again.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.4.victory: Well done.The Ordos dogs make amusing noises when they die, do they not?Indeed, what good is our life if we cannot enjoy the simple pleasures?
strings.campaign.harkonnen.4.defeat: Is this the way you repay my faith in you?Such a serious loss could only have been deliberate!You are unfit to clean our latrines, much less command our glorious Troopers!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.4.hints: The addition of tanks to your forces is essential to your victory in this region.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.5.briefing: So, the Emperor was helping the Ordos in your last mission.Nevertheless, House Atreides has grown stronger due to our negligence, and must now be taught a lesson.You will remove all the Atreides from this region.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.5.victory: In appreciation for your recent performance, I will now allow you to resume the struggle with the Ordos.At least they will put up a fight worthy of our Troopers.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.5.defeat: Perhaps you miss your mother?I am worried about you and cannot let you progress further until you have proved yourself against the Atreides.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.5.hints: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.6.briefing: You are to proceed into yet another region dominated by those pesky Ordos.I expect you to overcome this troublesome group.We have established a good reputation on this planet.Do not embarrass me now!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.6.victory: The victor`s laurels fit you well my son!I may even refer other aspirants to study your tactics.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.6.defeat: How could you manage such a defeat?I may have to slit your throat myself just to calm down!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.6.hints: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.7.briefing: Reports of new Atreides activity require that I send you immediately back to the front line.You do not seem to enjoy rest and relaxation anyway.I think you would prefer to crush the Atreides.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.7.victory: Congratulations.It is a pleasure to see the weak Atreides dealt with so severely!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.7.defeat: Your failure has caused me no end of embarrassment.It will not happen again!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.7.hints: The Devastator is a powerful ally against enemy forces.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.8.briefing: A commander of your status may require relaxation occasionally, but I expect an even greater efficiency on your part.Both Atreides and Ordos forces exist in this region, and all must be eliminated!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.8.victory: Although praise may be due, serving House Harkonnen is reward enough!We will speak fondly of you forever!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.8.defeat: Guards!How did this weakling get in here?If this happens again, I will personally dissect several of you!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.8.hints: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.9.briefing: We have been deceived!All have conspired against us, and so all must die!Destroy all of the Emperor`s forces.He has treated us poorly, and must not live another day!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.9.victory: You have served me, I mean House Harkonnen, well.Not only have you won a great victory, but you have made our enemies suffer!Rejoice, for Dune is finally ours forever!
strings.campaign.harkonnen.9.defeat: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.
strings.campaign.harkonnen.9.hints: Utilize your Palace`s special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.
strings.house.atreides.intro: House Atreides has a long tradition of being fair and just administrators.Our people are loyal, hard working, and peaceable.Do you wish to join House Atreides?
strings.campaign.atreides.1.briefing: Greetings, I am your Mentat Cyril.Together we will purge this planet of the foulness of the other Houses.The High Command wishes you to produce 1000 credits.You may earn credits by building a refinery and harvesting spice.
strings.campaign.atreides.1.victory: Congratulations!I knew that you would achieve your goal with very little trouble.I look forward to assisting you in future missions.
strings.campaign.atreides.1.defeat: This is very disappointing.We had such high hopes for you.We must insist that you try again.
strings.campaign.atreides.1.hints: First build concrete slabs, and then build a Windtrap and place it upon the concrete.Do the same for a refinery so that you can reach your quota of 1000 credits.
strings.campaign.atreides.2.briefing: Greetings, I am honored to see you again.You are now required to either produce 2700 credits in a new harvesting area or remove the Ordos base in this region.Good luck!
strings.campaign.atreides.2.victory: Well done!Our effort to maintain fair play on this planet is opposed by both the Ordos and the Harkonnen.This region will help us greatly in our efforts.
strings.campaign.atreides.2.defeat: The loss of this region to the Ordos will hurt House Atreides greatly.Please try harder next time.The seriousness of your mission cannot be overemphasized!
strings.campaign.atreides.2.hints: If you have an Outpost, build a Barracks in order to produce soldiers.I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.
strings.campaign.atreides.3.briefing: The battle with the other Houses has intensified, and we are now forced to engage in some selected offensive maneuvers.The Harkonnen are being extremely troublesome in your next region, and we must ask that you remove their presence from the area.
strings.campaign.atreides.3.victory: Hurrah!Although I prefer defense, a fine offensive against such a deserving foe as the Harkonnen is a joy to behold.House Atreides thanks you for your efforts!
strings.campaign.atreides.3.defeat: It is a cruel world, is it not?I`m not sure if I was expecting divine intervention, but as I watched your defeat I could not help thinking how unfair it was!
strings.campaign.atreides.3.hints: You need to build a Vehicle Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.
strings.campaign.atreides.4.briefing: Your demonstration of military skills now forces us to assign you to another offensive campaign against House Harkonnen.They have continued to attack our peaceful harvesters, and must be removed from the area!
strings.campaign.atreides.4.victory: Well done!No task seems too difficult for you.The Harkonnen will think twice before attacking our harvesters again!
strings.campaign.atreides.4.defeat: Although I understand the problems confronting you, I will confess that I am disappointed by your defeat.I am not sure what went wrong, but please do not let it happen again!
strings.campaign.atreides.4.hints: The addition of tanks in your forces is essential to your victory in this region.
strings.campaign.atreides.5.briefing: The rules seem to have changed.The Emperor himself has been aiding the efforts of our competitors!As a part of our new strategy, we must ask that you eliminate the treacherous Ordos forces that presently control this region.
strings.campaign.atreides.5.victory: Congratulations again!There seems to be no limit to your talents.I have to think that some divine force motivated your decision to serve within House Atreides.
strings.campaign.atreides.5.defeat: This defeat of yours will not look good in my reports.I am not sure how much longer we can afford to support you.
strings.campaign.atreides.5.hints: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.
strings.campaign.atreides.6.briefing: As the battle for this planet intensifies, all efforts must be taken to ensure our success.Once again, we must call upon you to destroy our enemies in a troubled sector.House Harkonnen must be taught a lesson.
strings.campaign.atreides.6.victory: Hurrah!We have them on the run now, and it`s all because of you.Your successes have been remarkable!Are you sure you didn`t graduate from one of the intergalactic military academies?
strings.campaign.atreides.6.defeat: There is a time for excuses, but this is not it!You have no choice but to apply yourself more diligently during your next assignment.
strings.campaign.atreides.6.hints: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.
strings.campaign.atreides.7.briefing: The battle goes well, but there is no time to relax.We have an urgent need for you to subdue all Ordos forces in this region promptly.We are counting on you.
strings.campaign.atreides.7.victory: Excellent!Your skill seems to improve with each assignment, and your exploits give great confidence to those on the home front.Keep up the good work!
strings.campaign.atreides.7.defeat: My goodness, what an awful defeat!If you fail at your next assignment we will have to seriously consider sending you home!
strings.campaign.atreides.7.hints: The Sonic Tank is a powerful ally against enemy troops and structures.
strings.campaign.atreides.8.briefing: Although you have earned a well deserved rest, I`m afraid we need to send you back into the field immediately.Both Ordos and Harkonnen forces have been spotted in this region, and now must be removed completely.
strings.campaign.atreides.8.victory: A masterful victory!Frankly, we would not be able to remain on Dune without your military guidance.We have come to rely completely on you sir, and cannot imagine further success without you!
strings.campaign.atreides.8.defeat: A defeat is never welcome, but this loss is particularly devastating!All of our efforts may soon prove futile unless you can provide a victory in your next campaign!
strings.campaign.atreides.8.hints: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.
strings.campaign.atreides.9.briefing: Your next assignment will determine the entire outcome of our efforts here on Dune.You are instructed to subdue Emperor Frederick`s forces.All of our hopes and dreams are riding with you, and we humbly beg of you to provide one final victory for our noble House Atreides.
strings.campaign.atreides.9.victory: Good Morning, your lordship, and congratulations!You showed great compassion in dealing with a distasteful task.Together we have succeeded in purging this planet of the foulness of the other Houses.
strings.campaign.atreides.9.defeat: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.
strings.campaign.atreides.9.hints: Utilize your Palace`s special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.
strings.house.ordos.intro: House Ordos represents a cartel of wealthy families.We have little conscience and gain strength through our use of sabotage and terrorism.Do you wish to join House Ordos?
strings.campaign.ordos.1.briefing: I am your Mentat, and you may call me Ammon.To be of any value to the Cartel, you must provide us with a quota of 1000 credits.Build a refinery to harvest the spice in the area to achieve your quota.
strings.campaign.ordos.1.victory: You show potential.If you continue to display good management skills we may find a permanent position for you in our organization.
strings.campaign.ordos.1.defeat: It is beyond me how you were able to fail such an easy task.Because you come so highly recommended, we may be able to overlook this episode if you are successful with your next assignment.
strings.campaign.ordos.1.hints: First build concrete slabs, and then build a Windtrap and place it upon the concrete.Do the same for a refinery so that you can reach your quota of 1000 credits.
strings.campaign.ordos.2.briefing: Your quota is now 2700 credits, or you may decide to destroy the Harkonnen forces in the area.Which ever task you choose, remember that we do not like competition, especially from the Harkonnens.
strings.campaign.ordos.2.victory: Congratulations.The Cartel is beginning to notice you.I think you will definitely have a future with us if you can continue on this track.
strings.campaign.ordos.2.defeat: Apparently, I was mistaken about your potential.It will cost us a great deal to retake this region.Only complete success with your next assignment could possibly resurrect your career.
strings.campaign.ordos.2.hints: If you have an Outpost, build a Barracks in order to produce soldiers.I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.
strings.campaign.ordos.3.briefing: We find the activities of Atreides troops in this region inconvenient.Please remove this obstacle.We cannot allow the mythical value of fair play to impede our progress.
strings.campaign.ordos.3.victory: Excellent!There were rumors that some sort of moral objections would hinder your effectiveness.I am glad to see that you have risen above these petty sensitivities.
strings.campaign.ordos.3.defeat: Your clumsy management has cost us dearly!I suggest you rid yourself of all outside interests and devote yourself completely to your next assignment!
strings.campaign.ordos.3.hints: You need to build a Vehicle Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.
strings.campaign.ordos.4.briefing: The Atreides forces in this area must be eliminated.As always, we appreciate your capture of any enemy silos or other structures that might be salvageable.
strings.campaign.ordos.4.victory: A masterful victory, but be cautious!Your reputation will now precede you in future engagements, and you may find your foes better prepared for your tactics.
strings.campaign.ordos.4.defeat: How could you possibly fail so quickly?My grandmother could command more efficiently than you!Get back out there and show some initiative, or stop wasting my time!
strings.campaign.ordos.4.hints: The addition of tanks to your forces is essential to your victory in this region.
strings.campaign.ordos.5.briefing: What?The Sarduakar were aiding our enemies during your last mission?I will need to look into this.Although the Harkonnen commanders are laughably stupid, their military strength is a threat to us in this area.They must be eliminated as soon as possible.
strings.campaign.ordos.5.victory: Congratulations would be in order, but we expect these results when you are in charge.Your continued success brings honor to your family, and all of us in House Ordos.
strings.campaign.ordos.5.defeat: You bungling fool!Did you expect your enemies to run away at the mere sight of you?Remember: your brain will win the war, not your bullets!
strings.campaign.ordos.5.hints: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.
strings.campaign.ordos.6.briefing: The Atreides have become far too vocal in this sector, and whine constantly about their rights.We Ordos do not have the leisure of pointless conversation, and must ask that you eliminate this distraction.
strings.campaign.ordos.6.victory: Well done!Your successful military campaigns have created a political atmosphere well suited to our particular bargaining skills.Keep up the good work!
strings.campaign.ordos.6.defeat: Do you instruct your troops to fire randomly into the air?Is there any plan to your idiotic maneuvers?I suggest that you no longer allow your dog to assist in managing your assignments!
strings.campaign.ordos.6.hints: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.
strings.campaign.ordos.7.briefing: Harkonnen forces continue to thwart our efforts in this region, and must be removed completely.Crush their beloved troopers and they will run crying back to their ugly mothers!
strings.campaign.ordos.7.victory: Excellent!You have won a great victory for House Ordos.Doesn`t inflicting such a humiliating defeat make your breakfast taste better?
strings.campaign.ordos.7.defeat: Your failure could not have been timed more poorly!What status and bargaining power can we maintain when you display such ineptitude in the field?
strings.campaign.ordos.7.hints: The Deviator is a powerful ally against enemy forces.
strings.campaign.ordos.8.briefing: Both Atreides and Harkonnen forces oppose our control of this area and must therefore be destroyed.The time for cooperation and compromise has past, and all enemies of House Ordos must be eliminated!
strings.campaign.ordos.8.victory: I just received the wonderful news of your stunning victory!I am very pleased, and look forward to telling my grandchildren that it was I who served as Mentat to such a brilliant Ordos commander.
strings.campaign.ordos.8.defeat: You do not exist in a vacuum!Your ineptitude has endangered everything House Ordos has worked to create here on Arrakis!
strings.campaign.ordos.8.hints: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.
strings.campaign.ordos.9.briefing: Emperor Frederick has joined the list of Ordos enemies, and must be punished.We expect you to destroy all of what remains of his forces.We have risked everything on this final battle, and cannot tolerate less than your best effort.
strings.campaign.ordos.9.victory: You have served House Ordos well.The cartel is pleased that you have kept our casualties at an acceptable, efficient level.Our business is so much more efficient when we have no competition left on the planet.
strings.campaign.ordos.9.defeat: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.
strings.campaign.ordos.9.hints: Utilize your Palace`s special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.

nativeTexts.114956: As the battle for this planet intensifies, all efforts must be taken to ensure our success.Once again, we must call upon you to destroy our enemies in a troubled sector.House Harkonnen must be taught a lesson.
nativeTexts.115166: Hurrah!We have them on the run now, and it`s all because of you.Your successes have been remarkable!Are you sure you didn`t graduate from one of the intergalactic military academies?
nativeTexts.115349: There is a time for excuses, but this is not it!You have no choice but to apply yourself more diligently during your next assignment.
nativeTexts.115483: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.
nativeTexts.115596: The battle goes well, but there is no time to relax.We have an urgent need for you to subdue all Ordos forces in this region promptly.We are counting on you.
nativeTexts.115754: Excellent!Your skill seems to improve with each assignment, and your exploits give great confidence to those on the home front.Keep up the good work!
nativeTexts.115904: My goodness, what an awful defeat!If you fail at your next assignment we will have to seriously consider sending you home!
nativeTexts.116027: The Sonic Tank is a powerful ally against enemy troops and structures.
nativeTexts.116098: Although you have earned a well deserved rest, I`m afraid we need to send you back into the field immediately.Both Ordos and Harkonnen forces have been spotted in this region, and now must be removed completely.
nativeTexts.116310: A masterful victory!Frankly, we would not be able to remain on Dune without your military guidance.We have come to rely completely on you sir, and cannot imagine further success without you!
nativeTexts.116501: A defeat is never welcome, but this loss is particularly devastating!All of our efforts may soon prove futile unless you can provide a victory in your next campaign!
nativeTexts.116667: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.
nativeTexts.116725: Your next assignment will determine the entire outcome of our efforts here on Dune.You are instructed to subdue Emperor Frederick`s forces.All of our hopes and dreams are riding with you, and we humbly beg of you to provide one final victory for our noble House Atreides.
nativeTexts.116997: Good Morning, your lordship, and congratulations!You showed great compassion in dealing with a distasteful task.Together we have succeeded in purging this planet of the foulness of the other Houses.
nativeTexts.117196: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.
nativeTexts.117310: Utilize your Palace`s special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.
nativeTexts.111730: House Ordos represents a cartel of wealthy families.We have little conscience and gain strength through our use of sabotage and terrorism.Do you wish to join House Ordos?
nativeTexts.117409: I am your Mentat, and you may call me Ammon.To be of any value to the Cartel, you must provide us with a quota of 1000 credits.Build a refinery to harvest the spice in the area to achieve your quota.
nativeTexts.117609: You show potential.If you continue to display good management skills we may find a permanent position for you in our organization.
nativeTexts.117740: It is beyond me how you were able to fail such an easy task.Because you come so highly recommended, we may be able to overlook this episode if you are successful with your next assignment.
nativeTexts.117929: First build concrete slabs, and then build a Windtrap and place it upon the concrete.Do the same for a refinery so that you can reach your quota of 1000 credits.
nativeTexts.118091: Your quota is now 2700 credits, or you may decide to destroy the Harkonnen forces in the area.Which ever task you choose, remember that we do not like competition, especially from the Harkonnens.
nativeTexts.118287: Congratulations.The Cartel is beginning to notice you.I think you will definitely have a future with us if you can continue on this track.
nativeTexts.118426: Apparently, I was mistaken about your potential.It will cost us a great deal to retake this region.Only complete success with your next assignment could possibly resurrect your career.
nativeTexts.118611: If you have an Outpost, build a Barracks in order to produce soldiers.I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.
nativeTexts.118755: We find the activities of Atreides troops in this region inconvenient.Please remove this obstacle.We cannot allow the mythical value of fair play to impede our progress.
nativeTexts.118925: Excellent!There were rumors that some sort of moral objections would hinder your effectiveness.I am glad to see that you have risen above these petty sensitivities.
nativeTexts.119090: Your clumsy management has cost us dearly!I suggest you rid yourself of all outside interests and devote yourself completely to your next assignment!
nativeTexts.119240: You need to build a Vehicle Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.
nativeTexts.119335: The Atreides forces in this area must be eliminated.As always, we appreciate your capture of any enemy silos or other structures that might be salvageable.
nativeTexts.119491: A masterful victory, but be cautious!Your reputation will now precede you in future engagements, and you may find your foes better prepared for your tactics.
nativeTexts.119649: How could you possibly fail so quickly?My grandmother could command more efficiently than you!Get back out there and show some initiative, or stop wasting my time!
nativeTexts.119813: The addition of tanks to your forces is essential to your victory in this region.
nativeTexts.119895: What?The Sarduakar were aiding our enemies during your last mission?I will need to look into this.Although the Harkonnen commanders are laughably stupid, their military strength is a threat to us in this area.They must be eliminated as soon as possible.
nativeTexts.120149: Congratulations would be in order, but we expect these results when you are in charge.Your continued success brings honor to your family, and all of us in House Ordos.
nativeTexts.120317: You bungling fool!Did you expect your enemies to run away at the mere sight of you?Remember: your brain will win the war, not your bullets!
nativeTexts.120457: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.
nativeTexts.120535: The Atreides have become far too vocal in this sector, and whine constantly about their rights.We Ordos do not have the leisure of pointless conversation, and must ask that you eliminate this distraction.
nativeTexts.120740: Well done!Your successful military campaigns have created a political atmosphere well suited to our particular bargaining skills.Keep up the good work!
nativeTexts.120892: Do you instruct your troops to fire randomly into the air?Is there any plan to your idiotic maneuvers?I suggest that you no longer allow your dog to assist in managing your assignments!
nativeTexts.121078: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.
nativeTexts.121191: Harkonnen forces continue to thwart our efforts in this region, and must be removed completely.Crush their beloved troopers and they will run crying back to their ugly mothers!
nativeTexts.121368: Excellent!You have won a great victory for House Ordos.Doesn`t inflicting such a humiliating defeat make your breakfast taste better?
nativeTexts.121502: Your failure could not have been timed more poorly!What status and bargaining power can we maintain when you display such ineptitude in the field?
nativeTexts.121649: The Deviator is a powerful ally against enemy forces.
nativeTexts.121703: Both Atreides and Harkonnen forces oppose our control of this area and must therefore be destroyed.The time for cooperation and compromise has past, and all enemies of House Ordos must be eliminated!
nativeTexts.121903: I just received the wonderful news of your stunning victory!I am very pleased, and look forward to telling my grandchildren that it was I who served as Mentat to such a brilliant Ordos commander.
nativeTexts.122099: You do not exist in a vacuum!Your ineptitude has endangered everything House Ordos has worked to create here on Arrakis!
nativeTexts.122220: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.
nativeTexts.122278: Emperor Frederick has joined the list of Ordos enemies, and must be punished.We expect you to destroy all of what remains of his forces.We have risked everything on this final battle, and cannot tolerate less than your best effort.
nativeTexts.122510: You have served House Ordos well.The cartel is pleased that you have kept our casualties at an acceptable, efficient level.Our business is so much more efficient when we have no competition left on the planet.
nativeTexts.122720: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.
nativeTexts.122834: Utilize your Palace`s special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.

house.harkonnen.intro.rawText: From the dark world of Giedi Prime the savage House Harkonnen has spread across the universe.A cruel people, we Harkonnen are ruthless towards both friend and foe in our fanatical pursuit of power.Do you wish to join House Harkonnen?

campaign.harkonnen.1.victory.rawText: You have pleased me.Continue to serve me well, and I will see to it that you are rewarded.

campaign.harkonnen.1.defeat.rawText: You are beneath my contempt.Do you know what happens to those who have failed House Harkonnen?

campaign.harkonnen.5.defeat.rawText: Perhaps you miss your mother?I am worried about you and cannot let you progress further until you have proved yourself against the Atreides.

campaign.harkonnen.5.hints.rawText: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.

campaign.harkonnen.6.briefing.rawText: You are to proceed into yet another region dominated by those pesky Ordos.I expect you to overcome this troublesome group.We have established a good reputation on this planet.Do not embarrass me now!

campaign.harkonnen.6.victory.rawText: The victor`s laurels fit you well my son!I may even refer other aspirants to study your tactics.

campaign.harkonnen.6.defeat.rawText: How could you manage such a defeat?I may have to slit your throat myself just to calm down!

campaign.harkonnen.6.hints.rawText: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.

campaign.harkonnen.7.briefing.rawText: Reports of new Atreides activity require that I send you immediately back to the front line.You do not seem to enjoy rest and relaxation anyway.I think you would prefer to crush the Atreides.

campaign.harkonnen.7.victory.rawText: Congratulations.It is a pleasure to see the weak Atreides dealt with so severely!

campaign.harkonnen.7.defeat.rawText: Your failure has caused me no end of embarrassment.It will not happen again!

campaign.harkonnen.7.hints.rawText: The Devastator is a powerful ally against enemy forces.

campaign.harkonnen.8.briefing.rawText: A commander of your status may require relaxation occasionally, but I expect an even greater efficiency on your part.Both Atreides and Ordos forces exist in this region, and all must be eliminated!

campaign.harkonnen.8.victory.rawText: Although praise may be due, serving House Harkonnen is reward enough!We will speak fondly of you forever!

campaign.harkonnen.8.defeat.rawText: Guards!How did this weakling get in here?If this happens again, I will personally dissect several of you!

campaign.harkonnen.8.hints.rawText: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.

campaign.harkonnen.9.briefing.rawText: We have been deceived!All have conspired against us, and so all must die!Destroy all of the Emperor`s forces.He has treated us poorly, and must not live another day!

campaign.harkonnen.9.victory.rawText: You have served me, I mean House Harkonnen, well.Not only have you won a great victory, but you have made our enemies suffer!Rejoice, for Dune is finally ours forever!

campaign.harkonnen.9.defeat.rawText: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.

campaign.harkonnen.9.hints.rawText: Utilize your Palace`s special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.

house.atreides.intro.rawText: House Atreides has a long tradition of being fair and just administrators.Our people are loyal, hard working, and peaceable.Do you wish to join House Atreides?

campaign.atreides.1.briefing.rawText: Greetings, I am your Mentat Cyril.Together we will purge this planet of the foulness of the other Houses.The High Command wishes you to produce 1000 credits.You may earn credits by building a refinery and harvesting spice.

campaign.atreides.1.victory.rawText: Congratulations!I knew that you would achieve your goal with very little trouble.I look forward to assisting you in future missions.

campaign.atreides.1.defeat.rawText: This is very disappointing.We had such high hopes for you.We must insist that you try again.

campaign.atreides.1.hints.rawText: First build concrete slabs, and then build a Windtrap and place it upon the concrete.Do the same for a refinery so that you can reach your quota of 1000 credits.

campaign.atreides.2.briefing.rawText: Greetings, I am honored to see you again.You are now required to either produce 2700 credits in a new harvesting area or remove the Ordos base in this region.Good luck!

campaign.atreides.2.victory.rawText: Well done!Our effort to maintain fair play on this planet is opposed by both the Ordos and the Harkonnen.This region will help us greatly in our efforts.

campaign.atreides.2.defeat.rawText: The loss of this region to the Ordos will hurt House Atreides greatly.Please try harder next time.The seriousness of your mission cannot be overemphasized!

campaign.atreides.2.hints.rawText: If you have an Outpost, build a Barracks in order to produce soldiers.I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.

campaign.atreides.3.briefing.rawText: The battle with the other Houses has intensified, and we are now forced to engage in some selected offensive maneuvers.The Harkonnen are being extremely troublesome in your next region, and we must ask that you remove their presence from the area.

campaign.atreides.3.victory.rawText: Hurrah!Although I prefer defense, a fine offensive against such a deserving foe as the Harkonnen is a joy to behold.House Atreides thanks you for your efforts!

campaign.atreides.3.defeat.rawText: It is a cruel world, is it not?I`m not sure if I was expecting divine intervention, but as I watched your defeat I could not help thinking how unfair it was!

campaign.atreides.3.hints.rawText: You need to build a Vehicle Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.

campaign.atreides.4.briefing.rawText: Your demonstration of military skills now forces us to assign you to another offensive campaign against House Harkonnen.They have continued to attack our peaceful harvesters, and must be removed from the area!

campaign.atreides.4.victory.rawText: Well done!No task seems too difficult for you.The Harkonnen will think twice before attacking our harvesters again!

campaign.atreides.4.defeat.rawText: Although I understand the problems confronting you, I will confess that I am disappointed by your defeat.I am not sure what went wrong, but please do not let it happen again!

campaign.atreides.4.hints.rawText: The addition of tanks in your forces is essential to your victory in this region.

campaign.atreides.5.briefing.rawText: The rules seem to have changed.The Emperor himself has been aiding the efforts of our competitors!As a part of our new strategy, we must ask that you eliminate the treacherous Ordos forces that presently control this region.

campaign.atreides.5.victory.rawText: Congratulations again!There seems to be no limit to your talents.I have to think that some divine force motivated your decision to serve within House Atreides.

campaign.atreides.5.defeat.rawText: This defeat of yours will not look good in my reports.I am not sure how much longer we can afford to support you.

campaign.atreides.5.hints.rawText: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.

campaign.atreides.6.briefing.rawText: As the battle for this planet intensifies, all efforts must be taken to ensure our success.Once again, we must call upon you to destroy our enemies in a troubled sector.House Harkonnen must be taught a lesson.

campaign.atreides.6.victory.rawText: Hurrah!We have them on the run now, and it`s all because of you.Your successes have been remarkable!Are you sure you didn`t graduate from one of the intergalactic military academies?

campaign.atreides.6.defeat.rawText: There is a time for excuses, but this is not it!You have no choice but to apply yourself more diligently during your next assignment.

campaign.atreides.6.hints.rawText: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.

campaign.atreides.7.briefing.rawText: The battle goes well, but there is no time to relax.We have an urgent need for you to subdue all Ordos forces in this region promptly.We are counting on you.

campaign.atreides.7.victory.rawText: Excellent!Your skill seems to improve with each assignment, and your exploits give great confidence to those on the home front.Keep up the good work!

campaign.atreides.7.defeat.rawText: My goodness, what an awful defeat!If you fail at your next assignment we will have to seriously consider sending you home!

campaign.atreides.7.hints.rawText: The Sonic Tank is a powerful ally against enemy troops and structures.

campaign.atreides.8.briefing.rawText: Although you have earned a well deserved rest, I`m afraid we need to send you back into the field immediately.Both Ordos and Harkonnen forces have been spotted in this region, and now must be removed completely.

campaign.atreides.8.victory.rawText: A masterful victory!Frankly, we would not be able to remain on Dune without your military guidance.We have come to rely completely on you sir, and cannot imagine further success without you!

campaign.atreides.8.defeat.rawText: A defeat is never welcome, but this loss is particularly devastating!All of our efforts may soon prove futile unless you can provide a victory in your next campaign!

campaign.atreides.8.hints.rawText: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.

campaign.atreides.9.briefing.rawText: Your next assignment will determine the entire outcome of our efforts here on Dune.You are instructed to subdue Emperor Frederick`s forces.All of our hopes and dreams are riding with you, and we humbly beg of you to provide one final victory for our noble House Atreides.

campaign.atreides.9.victory.rawText: Good Morning, your lordship, and congratulations!You showed great compassion in dealing with a distasteful task.Together we have succeeded in purging this planet of the foulness of the other Houses.

campaign.atreides.9.defeat.rawText: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.

campaign.atreides.9.hints.rawText: Utilize your Palace`s special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.

house.ordos.intro.rawText: House Ordos represents a cartel of wealthy families.We have little conscience and gain strength through our use of sabotage and terrorism.Do you wish to join House Ordos?

campaign.ordos.1.briefing.rawText: I am your Mentat, and you may call me Ammon.To be of any value to the Cartel, you must provide us with a quota of 1000 credits.Build a refinery to harvest the spice in the area to achieve your quota.

campaign.ordos.1.victory.rawText: You show potential.If you continue to display good management skills we may find a permanent position for you in our organization.

campaign.ordos.1.defeat.rawText: It is beyond me how you were able to fail such an easy task.Because you come so highly recommended, we may be able to overlook this episode if you are successful with your next assignment.

campaign.ordos.1.hints.rawText: First build concrete slabs, and then build a Windtrap and place it upon the concrete.Do the same for a refinery so that you can reach your quota of 1000 credits.

campaign.ordos.2.briefing.rawText: Your quota is now 2700 credits, or you may decide to destroy the Harkonnen forces in the area.Which ever task you choose, remember that we do not like competition, especially from the Harkonnens.

campaign.ordos.2.victory.rawText: Congratulations.The Cartel is beginning to notice you.I think you will definitely have a future with us if you can continue on this track.

campaign.ordos.2.defeat.rawText: Apparently, I was mistaken about your potential.It will cost us a great deal to retake this region.Only complete success with your next assignment could possibly resurrect your career.

campaign.ordos.2.hints.rawText: If you have an Outpost, build a Barracks in order to produce soldiers.I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.

campaign.ordos.3.briefing.rawText: We find the activities of Atreides troops in this region inconvenient.Please remove this obstacle.We cannot allow the mythical value of fair play to impede our progress.

campaign.ordos.3.victory.rawText: Excellent!There were rumors that some sort of moral objections would hinder your effectiveness.I am glad to see that you have risen above these petty sensitivities.

campaign.ordos.3.defeat.rawText: Your clumsy management has cost us dearly!I suggest you rid yourself of all outside interests and devote yourself completely to your next assignment!

campaign.ordos.3.hints.rawText: You need to build a Vehicle Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.

campaign.ordos.4.briefing.rawText: The Atreides forces in this area must be eliminated.As always, we appreciate your capture of any enemy silos or other structures that might be salvageable.

campaign.ordos.4.victory.rawText: A masterful victory, but be cautious!Your reputation will now precede you in future engagements, and you may find your foes better prepared for your tactics.

campaign.ordos.4.defeat.rawText: How could you possibly fail so quickly?My grandmother could command more efficiently than you!Get back out there and show some initiative, or stop wasting my time!

campaign.ordos.4.hints.rawText: The addition of tanks to your forces is essential to your victory in this region.

campaign.ordos.5.briefing.rawText: What?The Sarduakar were aiding our enemies during your last mission?I will need to look into this.Although the Harkonnen commanders are laughably stupid, their military strength is a threat to us in this area.They must be eliminated as soon as possible.

campaign.ordos.5.victory.rawText: Congratulations would be in order, but we expect these results when you are in charge.Your continued success brings honor to your family, and all of us in House Ordos.

campaign.ordos.5.defeat.rawText: You bungling fool!Did you expect your enemies to run away at the mere sight of you?Remember: your brain will win the war, not your bullets!

campaign.ordos.5.hints.rawText: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.

campaign.ordos.6.briefing.rawText: The Atreides have become far too vocal in this sector, and whine constantly about their rights.We Ordos do not have the leisure of pointless conversation, and must ask that you eliminate this distraction.

campaign.ordos.6.victory.rawText: Well done!Your successful military campaigns have created a political atmosphere well suited to our particular bargaining skills.Keep up the good work!

campaign.ordos.6.defeat.rawText: Do you instruct your troops to fire randomly into the air?Is there any plan to your idiotic maneuvers?I suggest that you no longer allow your dog to assist in managing your assignments!

campaign.ordos.6.hints.rawText: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.

campaign.ordos.7.briefing.rawText: Harkonnen forces continue to thwart our efforts in this region, and must be removed completely.Crush their beloved troopers and they will run crying back to their ugly mothers!

campaign.ordos.7.victory.rawText: Excellent!You have won a great victory for House Ordos.Doesn`t inflicting such a humiliating defeat make your breakfast taste better?

campaign.ordos.7.defeat.rawText: Your failure could not have been timed more poorly!What status and bargaining power can we maintain when you display such ineptitude in the field?

campaign.ordos.7.hints.rawText: The Deviator is a powerful ally against enemy forces.

campaign.ordos.8.briefing.rawText: Both Atreides and Harkonnen forces oppose our control of this area and must therefore be destroyed.The time for cooperation and compromise has past, and all enemies of House Ordos must be eliminated!

campaign.ordos.8.victory.rawText: I just received the wonderful news of your stunning victory!I am very pleased, and look forward to telling my grandchildren that it was I who served as Mentat to such a brilliant Ordos commander.

campaign.ordos.8.defeat.rawText: You do not exist in a vacuum!Your ineptitude has endangered everything House Ordos has worked to create here on Arrakis!

campaign.ordos.8.hints.rawText: Utilize Rocket turrets as a defense against Ornithopters.

campaign.ordos.9.briefing.rawText: Emperor Frederick has joined the list of Ordos enemies, and must be punished.We expect you to destroy all of what remains of his forces.We have risked everything on this final battle, and cannot tolerate less than your best effort.

campaign.ordos.9.victory.rawText: You have served House Ordos well.The cartel is pleased that you have kept our casualties at an acceptable, efficient level.Our business is so much more efficient when we have no competition left on the planet.

campaign.ordos.9.defeat.rawText: Your defects must have been inherited.Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.

campaign.ordos.9.hints.rawText: Utilize your Palace`s special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.
